rows.jyutping: jat1 geoi3 waa6 dou1 mou5 gong2 zau6 V
rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for doing something without saying a word.

example.english: They wordlessly picked up the bag and left.
example.traditional: 佢一句話都冇講就拎住個袋走咗。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 geoi3 waa6 dou1 mou5 gong2 zau6 ling1 zyu6 go3 doi2 zau2 zo2

rows.note: Use this when the focus is on remaining silent while carrying out the action.

example.english: They ate breakfast wordlessly, and the whole house was quiet.
example.traditional: 佢哋食早餐嗰陣唔出聲咁食，成間屋都靜晒。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 sik6 zou2 caan1 go2 zan6 m4 ceot1 seng1 gam3 sik6 seng4 gaan1 uk1 dou1 zing6 saai3

rows.jyutping: jat1 seng1 bat1 hoeng2 gam3 V
rows.note: Use this when the person leaves or acts without making any sound or announcement, not just without speaking.

example.english: They packed their things and left wordlessly.
example.traditional: 佢一聲不響咁執好啲嘢就離開咗。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 sing1 bat1 hoeng2 gam3 zap1 hou2 di1 je5 zau6 lei4 hoi1 zo2
